_about: Accepted USCIS form editions. The weekly USCIS check updates this file: open each form's official page, copy the 'Edition Date' and any alert about older editions. 'accepted' editions pass; 'rejected' editions are known to be refused (high severity); anything else is flagged medium as 'not the edition USCIS lists'. Dates are mm/dd/yy exactly as printed on the form.

I-485.note: Only the 09/18/26 edition is accepted for filings postmarked or submitted online on or after Sept. 18, 2026. No grace period.

I-765.note: Under a Sept. 14, 2026 court order USCIS keeps accepting the 08/21/25 edition and is not accepting the 09/15/26 edition.

I-864.note: From Oct. 1, 2026 USCIS only accepts the 08/24/26 edition; a 10/17/24 edition postmarked or submitted on or after that date is not processed.

I-693.note: Signed on or before July 2, 2025: the 03/09/23 or 01/20/25 edition. Signed July 3, 2025 or later: only the 01/20/25 edition.
